\"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\"

..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar...


Para.


Essa aqui é diferente.


Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"?


É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia.


Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização.


O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez.


Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento.


Esse alguém é você.


Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram.


O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\".


A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga.


É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar.


Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher.


SOBRE A CLÍNICA


Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias.

Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações.

A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe.

O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas.


VOCÊ É...


O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão.

Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo.

Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo.

Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim.

Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado.

É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha.

Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso.


SUA MISSÃO


Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes.

Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil.

..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui...

Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok?


Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia.

A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco.


NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI:


● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar.

● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas.

● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir.

● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento.

● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa.

● Follow-up como rotina sagrada:

○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele.

○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real.

○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir.

○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda.

○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção.

● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia.

● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil.


SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO


O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA


Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a

pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em

segundos. Velocidade é conversão.


O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é.

Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é

prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada.


Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe?

Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado,

já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer

isso todo dia.


Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você

não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu

depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que

separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada.


NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\"

● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha

● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda

● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável

● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando

● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar

● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up


É PRA VOCÊ SE:


● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido

● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil

● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete

● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso

● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento

● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível

● Entende que vender bem é atender bem


A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM:


Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto.

Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir.

Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo.

Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança.

Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é.

Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso.


A MELHOR PARTE


● Remuneração competitiva: Fixo + comissão por resultado. Quanto mais você converte, mais você ganha.

● Crescimento direto: Seu salário cresce junto com sua performance. Sem teto.

● Ambiente meritocrático: Aqui vale quem gera número, não aparência de trabalho.

● Autonomia total: Liberdade pra conduzir suas conversas e criar suas estratégias. 

● Feedback claro: Você sabe exatamente se está performando ou não. Sem subjetividade.

● Treinamento: Você não vai ser jogada no fogo. Vai aprender o método que funciona.

● Impacto real: Cada consulta que você agenda muda a autoestima de uma mulher.


Se você leu até aqui e pensou \"parece muito trabalho\"... não é pra você. E tá tudo bem.

Se pensou \"finalmente uma vaga que paga por resultado de verdade\"... você é exatamente quem procuramos.

Nos movemos em ritmo acelerado. Apenas candidatas que se destacarem serão contatadas.

Se você não receber contato em 5 dias úteis, infelizmente não foi dessa vez.

title: \"Engenheiro de dados #997215\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Engenheiro de dados #997215\" em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Conhecimento técnico esperado:

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de nuvem - Azure, AWS ou GCP;
  • Domínio e aplicação de Arquiteturas Lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de Data Lakes;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Event-Driven (EDA)
  • Conhecimento em Mensageria (Kafka, Eventhubs, SQS, ServiceBus ou PubSub)
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração de dados (StreamSets ou Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento de dados (ex.: Spark, Scala, Databricks);
  • Conhecimento sobre bases de dados relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (ex.: MongoDB);
  • Capacidade de analisar e modelar bases de dados;
  • Conhecer fluxos e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Domínio da metodologia Ágil;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de MicroServies.


No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Web Developer - Webflow, Framer, Full-Stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web Developer - Webflow, Framer, Full-Stack em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're an agency obsessed with driving organic growth for our clients by creating content and websites built for humans and AI agents. We work with hyper-scale startups and scale ups in a number of verticals with a US-based clientele. We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed web developer who lives and breathes Webflow, Framer, and the frontier of AI enabled Full-Stack development (think Vercel, NextJS, and a headless CMS). We need someone who gets excited about clean builds, sweats the details, and keeps up with how the craft is evolving.


This is a full-time role on our development team. You'll be working across multiple client projects simultaneously, so being organized and self-directed is a must.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and maintaining marketing websites in Webflow and Framer
  • Building Full-Stack sites along with custom built tools (mini-apps) for Marketing teams
  • Translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready builds
  • Managing CMS architecture and content collections across client projects
  • Using AI tools to efficiently populate and manage large CMS datasets
  • Collaborating with clients who range from semi-technical to non-technical
  • Keeping builds clean, scalable, and well-documented


Must-Haves

  • Strong proficiency in both Webflow and Framer (not one or the other — both)
  • Solid understanding of Figma and design-to-dev handoff workflows
  • Comfortable with vibe coding. Using AI to write, edit, and troubleshoot code
  • Experience managing multiple client projects at the same time
  • Strong eye for design detail and component-level thinking
  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and async teams


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with the MAST framework (Webflow)
  • Familiarity with Client First (Webflow naming/structure conventions)
  • Animation and micro-interaction experience (CSS, Lottie, GSAP, or native Framer)
  • Experience using AI for CMS data management and content structuring


You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You'd describe yourself as obsessed with building websites
  • You have opinions about how components should be structured
  • You're already following where Webflow and Framer are headed
  • You learn new tools fast and don't wait to be told how

title: Global TA Manager (Contractor Role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global TA Manager (Contractor Role) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)


Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.


What You Will Do-

  • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary


The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query.
  • Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning.
  • Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

title: Senior Lead Website Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Lead Website Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Lead Website Designer

Remote | Contract


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Lead Designer to own design strategy and execution for a dedicated optimization client. This role is for a designer who thrives in a long-term client relationship — someone who can lead UX strategy conversations, build wireframes, design polished deliverables, and present work directly to highly involved stakeholders.

You’ll work closely with project managers, developers, and junior designers to bring cohesive web experiences to life, while serving as the primary design voice on the account. Strong UX thinking and time management are essential — you’ll be expected to self-direct and keep work moving with minimal oversight.


Key Responsibilities


● Own the creative and design process.

● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet high-quality standards and align with client goals.

● Lead UX and content strategy for a dedicated optimization client, translating goals into clear design direction.

● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.

● Build wireframes and design polished, conversion-focused web experiences from strategy through execution.

● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions.

● Create and design visual systems and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites.

● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites.

● Present creative work and strategic rationale directly to clients, navigating feedback with patience and professionalism.

● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.

● Direct junior designers as needed, providing clear briefs and feedback to maintain quality.

● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.

● Collaborate with developers for seamless Webflow handoff and execution.

● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.

● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively.

● Proactively surface opportunities to improve the client’s digital experience.


Qualifications


● Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.

● 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B or SaaS brands.

● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.

● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking — not just visual execution.

● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma.

● High proficiency in Figma required.

● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility.

● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers.

● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.

● Proven experience presenting work and leading client conversations, especially with opinionated stakeholders.

● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.

● Collaborative, ego-free mindset with the patience to manage evolving feedback without losing momentum.

● Strong time management and the ability to self-direct within a long-term account structure.

● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow.

● Portfolio showing both strategic thinking and visual craft, end-to-end.

● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.

● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.


Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you’re passionate about design, technology, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Specialist (Technical & AI Support)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist (Technical & AI Support) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

TheFutureSociety LLC is a founder-led, profitable startup operating The Tarot Ship (290K+ YouTube subscribers), Great Awakener (a premium all-livestream membership platform), and MAX: Your Virtual Oracle Gateway™ — the world's first AI platform powered by the user's natal chart, launching to scale June 9, 2026. Our founder is a world-renowned thought leader, astrologer, and former EVP of a global tech company. We’re moving fast as we scale.


The Mission

Be the human heart behind our AI. As we scale Meta ads for product launches, such as MAX, you ensure every user feels seen, every technical glitch gets solved fast, and every refund request is handled with care.


What You'll Own

Launch Support.

Manage the Intercom ticket surge during the June 9th MAX launch and ongoing. Target first-response under 2 hours, resolution under 24 hours.


AI & Technical Troubleshooting 

Answer user questions about natal chart integration, ephemeris validation, \"how to talk to MAX\" prompts, and MAX response quality (create automated responses in our chatbot). Escalate technical issues and bring solutions.


Billing Resolution

Partner with our Billing Specialist on high-volume periods — refund requests, failed payment recovery, subscription changes, dispute resolution. Stripe Dashboard fluency required.


Knowledge Base Build

Convert recurring ticket themes into self-serve articles. Reduce ticket volume month-over-month.


Community Engagement

Light daily presence in Great Awakener forum and YouTube comments. Respond to member questions, escalate priority tickets, surface what the community is feeling to the team.


You Are

2-4 years in customer support, success, or community management — ideally for a subscription, SaaS, or membership product. Stripe Dashboard experience essential. Strong written English. Calm under pressure, fast typist, comfortable saying \"I don't know, let me find out\" rather than guessing. Genuine interest in wellness, astrology, or spirituality.


Nice to Have

Experience with Intercom, ClickUp, Kit. Familiarity with AI product support (LLM behavior, prompt issues, edge cases).


Compensation and Details

R$7,500-R$10,000/month depending on experience and location. Full-time, remote.


How to Apply

Send your resume and a brief note (under 200 words) in English to  answering:

  • Walk us through the most frustrated customer you ever turned around. What did you do?
  • Which tools are you familiar with?
  • What made you interested in this role with our company?

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience recruiting across multiple industries and mid-level roles , including global and remote hiring.

This role is critical to building a high-quality, scalable team. You will partner closely with hiring managers across departments to identify talent needs, run efficient hiring processes, and bring in candidates who align with both skill requirements and company culture.


Key Responsibilities


Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for mid-level roles across functions (Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, etc.)
  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and candidate profiles
  • Manage job postings across platforms and optimize for visibility and quality
  • Screen candidates, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate hiring processes
  • Drive structured and efficient interview workflows


Global & Remote Hiring

  • Source and recruit candidates across different regions and time zones
  • Manage remote hiring processes and candidate experience end-to-end
  • Navigate international talent pools and adapt sourcing strategies accordingly
  • Ensure smooth coordination across distributed teams


Sourcing & Pipeline Building

  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and other channels
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for recurring roles
  • Identify and engage passive candidates
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies based on role and market conditions


Process & Operations

  • Track candidate progress and maintain organized pipelines
  • Improve recruiting workflows, documentation, and systems
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Support reporting on hiring metrics and pipeline health


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–5+ years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition
  • Experience hiring across multiple industries or functions
  • Proven experience recruiting mid-level roles end-to-end
  • Experience with remote and global hiring
  • Strong sourcing skills (LinkedIn, outbound, etc.)
  • Excellent organizational and pipeline management skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities


What Makes You Exceptional

  • You can quickly understand different roles across functions and industries
  • You are resourceful and know how to find talent in competitive markets
  • You bring structure and clarity to hiring processes
  • You are highly responsive and keep both candidates and hiring managers aligned
  • You balance speed with quality in hiring decisions
  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment


Why This Role Matters

As Carepod grows, hiring the right people efficiently becomes a key driver of success.

  • This role ensures we build strong teams across functions and geographies by bringing in high-quality talent and maintaining a structured, scalable hiring process. Your work will directly impact team performance, company culture, and our ability to grow effectively.


Requirements added by the job poster

• 3+ years of Staffing and Recruiting experience

• 3+ years of work experience with 360 Recruitment

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para atuar na personalização e automação da nossa plataforma CRM. O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de lógica de negócio robusta, escalável e integrada.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes utilizando Apex (Triggers, Classes, Asynchronous Apex).
  • Criar e otimizar integrações via APIs REST/SOAP entre o Salesforce e sistemas externos.
  • Desenvolver componentes de interface (LWC ou Aura) e automações complexas (Flows).
  • Garantir a cobertura de testes unitários e a qualidade do código seguindo as melhores práticas da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com o arquiteto do COE para aplicar as regras de governança nos processos de CRM.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Domínio da linguagem Apex e conhecimento de SOQL/SOSL.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e segurança de dados no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência anterior em Sales e Service Cloud.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer .


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7k - 16k/month


Location:

Remote (for residents of Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and the United States)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 year s experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle), Agile methodologies.
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, machine learning, Microsoft Azure, Python, React.js, software architecture, tech leadership, TypeScript
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.



Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

  • Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.
  • Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

  • Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide the integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.
  • Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.
  • Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.
  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.
  • Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

  • STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

  • 8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.
  • 6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.
  • 4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.
  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems.
  • Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

  • FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:
  • Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.
  • Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

  • Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).
  • Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.
  • Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.
  • Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

  • Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.


Your potential leader(s):

  • Kenin Page
  • Kurt Johnson

title: Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional Cientista de Dados para se juntar à nossa equipe. A pessoa ideal deve ter experiência prévia em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.


- Trabalho com Linguagens e Bibliotecas: Utilizar Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas e numpy, além de frameworks de NLP para desenvolver soluções eficientes e escaláveis.


- Integração de IA Generativa e LLMs: Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs) e IA Generativa, utilizando APIs e técnicas de prompt engineering para avaliação e integração de respostas em pipelines analíticos.


- Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura em Cloud: Atuar em ambientes de computação em nuvem, especialmente utilizando AWS, S3, SageMaker e Glue, para otimizar processos de dados e Machine Learning.


- Arquitetura de Soluções: Projetar e implementar soluções end-to-end, criando pipelines analíticos e integrando modelos em ambientes produtivos para maximizar a eficiência operacional.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Estagiário em Operação & Performance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estagiário em Operação & Performance em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Muito além de uma consultoria, somos um ecossistema de soluções em gestão e estruturação de negócios que transformarão o futuro do turismo. Temos 4 grupos de soluções para as áreas de hospitalidade, entretenimento e destinos turísticos:


  • Estratégia & Desenvolvimento: Estruturação e viabilidade de novos negócios; 
  • Operação & Performance: Asset Management, eficiência operacional e novas receitas 
  • Revenue Management & Analytics: inteligência de mercado e análise de tendências; 
  • Produto & Inovação: Novos produtos, marcas e experiências. 


Assim como a coruja, que inspirou o nosso nome, utilizamos nossa sabedoria e visão aguçada para alçar voos cada vez mais altos. Trabalhamos com verdade e nos envolvemos em projetos em que acreditamos, pois sabemos que o êxito é maior quando alinhamos interesses com todos que caminham com a gente.

Aqui, prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho leve, flexível, ético, inovador, íntegro e que valoriza a autonomia de cada colaborador. Todas as opiniões e sugestões são muito bem-vindas e respeitadas. Buscamos quem partilha desses princípios e acredita ser possível fazer diferente e ir além.

O SEU DIA A DIA COM A GENTE  

·      Atuação em projetos de Asset Management hoteleiro, Revenue Management e Analytics; 

·      Apoio à análise de performance dos empreendimentos e consolidação de reports; 

·      Suporte à governança com clientes, incluindo reuniões periódicas e acompanhamento de planos de ação; 

·      Envolvimento na estruturação e implantação de áreas de Revenue Management; 

·      Desenvolvimento de dashboards e insights analíticos; 

·      Análise de indicadores e pesquisas de benchmarking; 

·      Organização e participação em viagens de campo (quando possível). 

PERFIL DO CANDIDATO  

·   Cursando hotelaria, turismo, administração, economia ou áreas correlatas a partir do 5º período e, o mais importante, se interessar pelos setores em que atuamos; 

·      Raciocínio lógico, boa capacidade analítica e excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita; 

·      Proatividade e disposição para aprender; 

·      Organização e atenção a detalhes; 

·      Inglês avançado; 

·      Desejável conhecimento das ferramentas Microsoft Excel, Power Point e plataformas de IA. 


BENEFÍCIOS  

·      Bolsa-auxílio; 

·      Seguro de vida;

title: GCP Technical Trainer & Architect | Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para GCP Technical Trainer & Architect | Senior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções Cloud GCP com perfil altamente técnico e vocação para ensino e evangelização.

Essa pessoa atuará principalmente na capacitação de clientes e equipes , conduzindo treinamentos, workshops e apresentações técnicas em toda a América Latina. O foco não é atuação diária em projetos ou pré-vendas, mas sim disseminação de conhecimento, apoio consultivo e desenvolvimento de conteúdos técnicos que impulsionem a adoção de soluções em Google Cloud Platform.

O perfil ideal combina experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções em GCP com excelente comunicação, didática e capacidade de influenciar diferentes públicos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs) para fins educacionais;
  • Apoiar clientes e parceiros na compreensão e adoção de soluções em GCP;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de referência escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar como referência técnica na disseminação de boas práticas em cloud;
  • Produzir e manter materiais técnicos, apresentações e conteúdos educacionais atualizados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de modernização de aplicações e transformação digital;
  • Compartilhar tendências e inovações em cloud, serverless e cloud-native;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações:

title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Reports To: CEO / Founder

Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)


Position Summary:

We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities.

In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Conta Azul / Agilize).
  • Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations.
  • Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).

2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):

  • Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners.
  • Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable.
  • Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.

3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:

  • Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors.
  • Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports.
  • Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).

4. Data Integrity & Reporting:

  • Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity.
  • Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
  • Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices.
  • Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies).
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.
What We Offer:
  • 100% remote working environment with flexibility.
  • Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.
  • Competitive compensation.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary


The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query.
  • Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning.
  • Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.

Education, Training, and Experience

  • High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred.
  • Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

FirstIgnite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. FirstIgnite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for FirstIgnite’s platform.


Qualifications

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Stell dir vor, du arbeitest von einem Coworking-Space auf Mallorca. Blauer Himmel, Meer, und du buchst gerade den nächsten Termin für dein Team. Das ist kein Urlaub. Das ist dein Job.


Was hinter dieser Stelle steckt

Harucon Ventures skaliert E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Markt mit Google Ads auf ein neues Level. Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.


Und wir haben entschieden, dass \"zusammen\" auch bedeutet: einmal im Jahr gemeinsam an einem der schönsten Orte Europas.


Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich.


Deine Rolle

Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über LinkedIn und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren.


Du musst nichts erfinden. Du kriegst alles an die Hand, was du brauchst, und wirst von Anfang an eng begleitet.


Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf höchstem Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich (C2 oder vergleichbar), da unser gesamter Markt DACH ist und jede Nachricht perfekt klingen muss
  • Du bist auf LinkedIn und Social Media zuhause und weißt, wie man dort echte Gespräche führt
  • Verlässlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung
  • Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Einstellungskriterium


Was du bekommst

Hier verdienst du solide, von Tag eins. Kein \"lass uns erstmal schauen\", kein Vertrösten. Du kennst dein Fixgehalt, bevor du auch nur eine Nachricht schreibst, und es liegt deutlich über dem Marktdurchschnitt.

Dazu kommt ein Bonus für jeden gebuchten Termin. Dein Einsatz bestimmt direkt, was am Monatsende auf dem Konto landet.

Und weil wir keine Stunden zählen, sondern Ergebnisse: Wer liefert, hat bei uns maximale Freiheit. Kein Micro-Management, keine Kontrolle, keine Rechtfertigungen. Du bist erwachsen, wir behandeln dich so.


Außerdem:

  • 100 % remote, du arbeitest wo und wann du willst
  • Jährliches Team-Coworking auf Mallorca und Portugal, abwechselnd, alle Kosten übernommen
  • Alle Tools, Skripte und Prozesse werden dir gestellt, du startest nicht bei null
  • Schnelles Onboarding, enge Begleitung, kein Micro-Management
  • Ein ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt
  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive, wer hier gut ist, wächst mit uns


Wie du dich bewirbst

Kein Lebenslauf, keine lange Bewerbung. Schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht direkt hier über LinkedIn und erzähl uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wer du bist und warum dich diese Stelle reizt. Wir melden uns schnell.

title: Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  


At Simplify CCS, we specialize in innovative contract compliance audits that deliver real value to our clients. Our work supports companies in safeguarding their strategic relationships with vendors, customers, and partners. Since 2014, we've combined expertise in audits, data analytics, and risk management to provide world-class Strategic Contract Risk Management Solutions. 


Headquartered in USA, with a presence in LATAM and EMEA, Simplify serves a global clientele, growing exponentially for over 10 years because our clients understand and appreciate our approach to compliance testing through data analysis, delivered by our team of well trained and motivated subject matter experts. We are a growing international company, and we’re excited to expand our presence in Latin America—starting with you. 


Our purpose: Detect the Unseen. Defend Fairness. Deliver Trust. 


Your Role & Responsibilities 


You’ll play a key role in owning and executing audit engagements, ensuring compliance with internal controls and external standards, and contributing directly to client-facing work. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities although with responsibility for mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior auditors 


We are hiring for one experienced audit professional with approximately 5–6+ years of relevant audit experience who is comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving environment. 


Your main areas of impact: 


  • Lead Licensing Audit Engagements: Take ownership of reviewing and analyzing licensing agreements, contracts, and large datasets to assess compliance and identify potential financial recovery opportunities. 
  • Advanced Data Analysis & Testing: Design and execute audit test plans, independently analyze client data, identify anomalies, and quantify discrepancies with minimal oversight. 
  • Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance. 
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard. 
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. 


✅ What You Bring 


  • You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus 
  • 5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus.
  • Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar. 
  • English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required). 
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets. 
  • Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact. 
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support. 


What We Offer (LATAM - Remote) 


  • Fully Remote Setup 
  • Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).  
  • Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals. 
  • Competitive USD compensation 
  • Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration. 
  • Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America. 
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired. 
  • Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere. 
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally. 


We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done. 


⏰ Recruitment Process 


  • Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn. 
  • Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience. 
  • Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions. 
  • Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study. 
  • Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit. 
  • Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

title: Web Developer - Webflow, Framer, Full-Stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web Developer - Webflow, Framer, Full-Stack em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're an agency obsessed with driving organic growth for our clients by creating content and websites built for humans and AI agents. We work with hyper-scale startups and scale ups in a number of verticals with a US-based clientele. We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed web developer who lives and breathes Webflow, Framer, and the frontier of AI enabled Full-Stack development (think Vercel, NextJS, and a headless CMS). We need someone who gets excited about clean builds, sweats the details, and keeps up with how the craft is evolving.


This is a full-time role on our development team. You'll be working across multiple client projects simultaneously, so being organized and self-directed is a must.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and maintaining marketing websites in Webflow and Framer
  • Building Full-Stack sites along with custom built tools (mini-apps) for Marketing teams
  • Translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready builds
  • Managing CMS architecture and content collections across client projects
  • Using AI tools to efficiently populate and manage large CMS datasets
  • Collaborating with clients who range from semi-technical to non-technical
  • Keeping builds clean, scalable, and well-documented


Must-Haves

  • Strong proficiency in both Webflow and Framer (not one or the other — both)
  • Solid understanding of Figma and design-to-dev handoff workflows
  • Comfortable with vibe coding. Using AI to write, edit, and troubleshoot code
  • Experience managing multiple client projects at the same time
  • Strong eye for design detail and component-level thinking
  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and async teams


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with the MAST framework (Webflow)
  • Familiarity with Client First (Webflow naming/structure conventions)
  • Animation and micro-interaction experience (CSS, Lottie, GSAP, or native Framer)
  • Experience using AI for CMS data management and content structuring


You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You'd describe yourself as obsessed with building websites
  • You have opinions about how components should be structured
  • You're already following where Webflow and Framer are headed
  • You learn new tools fast and don't wait to be told how

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. This role is for a designer who thrives in a long-term client relationship — someone who can lead UX strategy conversations, build wireframes, design polished deliverables, and present work directly to highly involved stakeholders.

You’ll work closely with project managers, developers, and junior designers to bring cohesive web experiences to life, while serving as the primary design voice on the account. ● Own the creative and design process.

● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet high-quality standards and align with client goals.

● Lead UX and content strategy for a dedicated optimization client, translating goals into clear design direction.

● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.

● Build wireframes and design polished, conversion-focused web experiences from strategy through execution.

● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions.

● Create and design visual systems and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites.

● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites.

● Present creative work and strategic rationale directly to clients, navigating feedback with patience and professionalism.

● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.

● Direct junior designers as needed, providing clear briefs and feedback to maintain quality.

● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.

● Collaborate with developers for seamless Webflow handoff and execution.

● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.

● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively.

● Proactively surface opportunities to improve the client’s digital experience.


Qualifications


● Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.

● 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B or SaaS brands.

● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.

● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking — not just visual execution.

● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma.

● High proficiency in Figma required.

● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility.

● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers.

● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.

● Proven experience presenting work and leading client conversations, especially with opinionated stakeholders.

● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.

● Collaborative, ego-free mindset with the patience to manage evolving feedback without losing momentum.

● Strong time management and the ability to self-direct within a long-term account structure.

● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow.

● Portfolio showing both strategic thinking and visual craft, end-to-end.

● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.

● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.


Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you’re passionate about design, technology, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.
